newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 2.12 pct on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 2.12 pct on profit taking.

text.p: Thai stocks declined 2.12 percent to 665.10 points as investors sold finance and bank issues and took profits, brokers said.

"Investors sold finance and banks and took profits. The country's key economic indicators released by the central bank a while ago didn't help the market at all," said Witawus Charuchandr of Ekachart Finance.
At 0912 GMT, the index slipped further to 663.42, down 16.11 points or 2.37 percent.
